_comment: Pinned GROUNDING program for the multi-clip FILTER-ON-A-NON-HERO-VALUE query 'Does #7 score the first goal?' on the best-goal clip. Same detect->crop->read_text->filter->temporal_order->answer shape as the hero, but filters on text == '7' (a DIFFERENT pinned jersey than the hero's #10), so it stresses grounding on a non-hero value end to end. This is the clip's self-validation target (Phase 4): it declares a goal event scored by p_seven, so self_validate_replay asserts findings.grounded is True. Window 8000-13000 @ fps 8 (stride 125) covers the goal moment (~8500ms) and the scorer frame (~9000ms). Validates against ../schema/dsl.schema.json.
